egitim.aciklama: Your courses, students, class schedule and attendance, online lessons, quizzes and assignments, certificates — all in one place.
egitim.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own courses and (for support) customers' courses: schedule, students, attendance, lessons, quizzes and certificates.
egitim.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; select and copy it manually.

kurslar.yeniAciklama: Enter a name; you can set dates, schedule, registration and certificate options later.
kurslar.adOrnek: e.g. Intro to Python — weekend group
kurslar.hesap: Customer account (empty = the agency's own course)
kurslar.bos: No courses yet. Create your first course above.
kurslar.bosEgitmen: You are not an instructor on any course.
kurslar.egitmenNotu: As an instructor you only see courses you teach: schedule and attendance, lessons, quiz results and grading assignments.

ayar.markdownIpucu: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, - list, [link](https://…). HTML is not rendered.
ayar.egitmenIpucu: If an instructor's email matches a team member with the `egitim_egitmen` permission, that person sees only this course.
ayar.bitisIpucu: Student links and the retention period count from this date (or from the last class).
ayar.onlineIpucu: Shown only on enrolled (active) students' pages and in reminders.
ayar.kapasiteIpucu: Empty = unlimited. When full, registrations go to the waiting list (if enabled).
ayar.fiyatIpucu: Information text only: no payment is taken on the site; describe how to pay.
ayar.fiyatOrnek: e.g. €450 (2 instalments) — payment details by email after registration
ayar.hedefIpucu: For children's courses (or under-18 in mixed courses) a parent's name and email are required; emails go to the parent.
ayar.listedeGoster: Show on the course list page
ayar.kvkkIpucu: If left empty, the standard privacy notice is shown. Explain what data is collected, why, and for how long.
ayar.saklamaIpucu: Student data is anonymised this many days after the course ends ({{en_az}}–{{en_cok}} days). Certificate verification continues with a masked name.
ayar.devamsizlikIpucu: A student (the parent for minors) who misses this many classes gets one email warning and the `egitim.devamsizlik` event is sent to automations. 0 = off.
ayar.hatirlatmaIpucu: Email to active students before each class.
ayar.otomatikSertifika: Issue automatically when conditions are met
ayar.kosulIpucu: All three conditions are required. With no quizzes the quiz condition counts as met; with no lessons the progress condition does.
ayar.kurumAdiIpucu: Shown on certificates and the verification page.
ayar.listeAciklama: List your published courses on one page; each course links to its own registration page.
ayar.kvkk: Student data: only name, contact details and (for under-18s) parent details are collected; no date of birth, ID number or home address. Data is anonymised when the retention period ends.
ayar.silOnay: Move the course to the recycle bin? Student data will be anonymised; this cannot be undone.

ogrenci.csvIpucu: First row is the header: ad, eposta, telefon, cocuk, veli_ad, veli_eposta, veli_telefon. If the course is full, rows go to the waiting list.
ogrenci.csvSonuc: {{aktif}} active, {{bekleme}} added to the waiting list; {{atlanan}} already enrolled, {{hata}} rows with errors.
ogrenci.yenileOnay: The old student link will stop working. Renew it?
ogrenci.silOnay: Permanently delete {{ad}} and all their records (attendance, quizzes, assignments, certificate)?
ogrenci.kvkkNotu: Deletion is permanent (data erasure request). When a student leaves, the first person on the waiting list takes the place automatically.

program.bos: No classes yet. Generate a recurring schedule above.
program.uretIpucu: Creates classes on the selected weekdays at the given time across the date range. Existing classes at the same time are skipped.
program.silOnay: Delete this class and its attendance?

yoklama.kod: Code to write on the board
yoklama.ipucu: Students scan the QR with their phone or enter the code on their page. You can also scan a student's personal QR.
yoklama.yenileOnay: The old QR and code will stop working (e.g. if a photo was shared). Renew?

ders.ipucu: Reorder with the arrows. Draft lessons are hidden from students.
ders.bolumIpucu: Lessons with the same section name are grouped together on the student page.
ders.videoIpucu: YouTube, Vimeo or any https link. Students open the video in a new tab (it is not embedded).
ders.silOnay: Delete the lesson "{{ad}}" and its files?

quiz.sureIpucu: Empty = no limit. When time runs out, answers are submitted automatically.
quiz.kabulIpucu: One answer per line. Case and accents are ignored.
quiz.notVerildi: Grade saved; the student has been notified.

ai.kapali: AI question generation is off (no AI key configured). You can add questions manually.
ai.krediIle: {{kredi}} credits per generation after the allowance
ai.onayIpucu: Generated questions are drafts: review them and pick the ones you want; the selected ones are added to the quiz and nothing is published until you save.

sertifika.kapali: Certificates are off for this course. You can turn them on in the General tab.
sertifika.kosulOzeti: Conditions: progress at least {{ilerleme}}%, quiz average at least {{quiz}}, attendance at least {{yoklama}}%.
sertifika.otomatikNotu: Students who meet the conditions receive the certificate automatically (scheduled task).
sertifika.topluSonuc: {{verilen}} certificates issued; {{kalan}} students don't meet the conditions yet.
sertifika.zorlaOnay: {{ad}} does not meet the conditions. Issue a certificate anyway?
sertifika.verildi: Certificate issued and emailed to the student.
sertifika.iptalOnay: Revoke this certificate? The verification page will show "revoked".

duyuru.aciklama: An informational email to the course's active students (the parent for under-18s): schedule changes, assignment reminders and the like. Not a marketing email.
